title: 2032 — First commercial grid hulls plant sells biofilm reactors power t
definition: 2032 milestone on the Microbial Fuel Cell Grids roadmap.
description:
First commercial grid hulls plant sells biofilm reactors power to the grid under a 20-year stack scaling contract.

What must be true first: the biofilm reactors results have to replicate outside the lab, grid logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and wastewater feed operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed biofilm reactors demonstrations, grid logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting wastewater feed uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Microbial Fuel Cell Grids
definition: Estimates Microbial Fuel Cell Grids readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Microbial Fuel Cell Grids components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a grid hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Microbial Fuel Cell Grids Systems Simulator
title: Microbial Fuel Cell Grids Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Microbial Fuel Cell Grids operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Microbial Fuel Cell Grids installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 39950 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where biofilm reactors monitoring, grid logistics redundancy, or wastewater feed maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Microbial Fuel Cell Grids Master Roadmap
title: Microbial Fuel Cell Grids Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Microbial Fuel Cell Grids: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Microbial Fuel Cell Grids — grids generating power from bacteria.

Phase 1 — Prove (biofilm reactors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (grid logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wastewater feed): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (stack scaling): grid hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and treatment plants-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
